Designed for Real Connections

Every feature built with intention. No noise, no algorithms—just meaningful moments.

Frame Collections

Organize your moments into beautiful frame collections. Tell stories that matter, not just random posts.

Circles of Trust

Share different frames with different circles. Family, friends, creators—you control who sees what.

Frame Highlights

Your best moments deserve spotlight. Highlight frames stay pinned, creating your personal gallery.

Privacy-First Design

Your data stays yours. End-to-end encryption on private frames. No ads, no tracking, no selling.

Frame Conversations

Rich threading that keeps conversations attached to frames. Context preserved, discussions meaningful.

Global & Local

Discover frames from around the world or just your neighborhood. Toggle between global and local feeds.
